# GITM — Groupe Innovation Technologique Maroc

> Official web platform of Groupe Innovation Technologique Maroc (مجموعة الابتكار التكنولوجي المغرب — GITM), founded and led by Mohammed Rhzaouni (محمد غزاوني) in Oued Zem, Morocco. Focuses on robotics, embedded systems, AI, IoT, VR/AR, and technology education.

## Public Pages
- [Home](https://gitm.pages.dev/): Overview of GITM innovation lab, leadership, projects, and academy.
- [About Us](https://gitm.pages.dev/about-us): Mission, vision, founding story, and leadership team.
- [Projects Hub](https://gitm.pages.dev/projects-hub): Showcase of GITM projects (EduConnect, Morocco Heritage VR, Solar Smart Irrigation, Medina VR, Atlas Spirit Robot, AgriTech).
- [Academy](https://gitm.pages.dev/academy): Training courses and educational resources.
- [Events](https://gitm.pages.dev/events): GITM, national, and international tech events.
- [News](https://gitm.pages.dev/news): Official GITM updates and tech/environment news.
- [Gallery](https://gitm.pages.dev/gallery): Visual showcase of GITM activities.
- [Verify Certificate](https://gitm.pages.dev/verify-certificate): Public certificate verification tool.
- [Contact](https://gitm.pages.dev/contact): Contact GITM Innovation Lab (Oued Zem, Morocco).

## Read-Only MCP Server (Streamable HTTP / JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **Endpoint:** `https://gitm.pages.dev/mcp` (open CORS, no authentication required)
- **Server Info:** `GET https://gitm.pages.dev/mcp`
- **Available Tools:** `list_news`, `list_events`, `list_projects`, `list_courses`, `list_team`
